name: ca-saas-monorepo
description: CA Practice Automation SaaS - Enterprise Full-Stack Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npx prisma generate && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
